svg.title: Schematic XRD phase evolution of a bioactive silicate ceramic, 700–1100 °C
svg.desc: Offset X-ray diffraction patterns with reference stick patterns for wollastonite, whitlockite and hydroxyapatite/fluorapatite.
svg.text: Phase evolution of bioactive silicate ceramic vs. sintering temperature
Schematic illustration · Cu Kα (λ = 1.5406 Å) · normalised intensity, offset
Illustrative patterns and approximate reference angles — not measured data. Replace with experimental scans and ICDD/COD-derived peak lists before citing.
HA and FAp overlap at Cu Kα (≈31.8°, 32.2°, 32.9°); XRD alone cannot distinguish them.
